## Summary

I've extracted the existing design system and created two files:

**`design-tokens.json`** (87 lines)
- Consolidates colors from 5 CSS files and component inline styles into a unified palette
- Captures spacing scale (2px–24px normalized to 8 tokens)
- Documents border radius (6px, 8px, 999px), typography (font family, 6 sizes, 2 weights, 4 line heights), and focus states
- Flags consolidation issues: multiple muted grays (#6b7280, #6c7280, #71717a, #737373) due to lack of reuse

**`DESIGN-SYSTEM.md`** (187 lines)
- Explains what's already in the code without changing it
- Documents why 3 years of drift occurred (multiple stylesheets, incomplete rebrand, inline styles for one-offs)
- Maps each token to its actual usage in components (buttons, cards, alerts, tables, navigation, calendar)
- Details the file organization and component variance patterns
- Notes out-of-scope migration paths

**Verified:**
- No src/ files modified; extraction only
- All 5 CSS files scanned (vars.css, base.css, components.css, utilities.css, legacy.css)
- All component inline styles captured (Button, Card, Alert, Calendar)
- JSON valid, markdown well-formed
- Color drift documented (4 redundant grays, color format inconsistency with legacy.css using rgb/hsl)
